subject: attn
title: (R)ATTN.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in CMBA-27. (R)ATTN — the reality of attraction — is crossed with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). The diagram poses what real attraction (the actual draw a music exerts on its audience and its players) requires structurally to be more than fashion. ATTN branches to AFL (affinity alignment) and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). AFL in turn branches to CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) and AFTD (affinity tendencies), and AFTD leads to SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars), which has a *dashed* edge to (R)AFI (the reality of affinity insight). AFI branches to C-INFO (composite information) and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). Real affinity insight, once established, produces dynamic functionalism.
